terms: ## Conversational Texture The user explicitly asked not to expand B-5952 and questioned the time spent. This bug is isolated as its own main-baseline story so B-5952 remains a narrow 800-to-808 instrumentation repair, and the new work is limited to the gate defect that makes legal reviewer evidence impossible to consume.

## Key Insights The committed review-incremental-context smoke passes its temporal-cutoff and production-verifier scenarios, while the real story with prior rounds and resolved findings fails repeatedly. The missing coverage is therefore the real persisted-history composition, not the bounded-inventory implementation.

## Solution Tradeoffs The fix must preserve fail-closed rejection for real task, scope, role, runtime, material, and cutoff changes. It must not bypass Prompt Envelope verification or special-case B-5952; the smallest acceptable change is a deterministic as-of-run recomputation plus a regression using realistic prior rounds.

## Trigger Event B-5952 recorded fresh reviewer passes RP-018 through RP-020 in a clean REVIEW round, but REVIEW to TEST rejected all three with review_evidence_invalid on eligibilityDigest, eligibilityReasonCodes, and reviewBasisDigest.

On clean main, B-5952 produced fresh concept, quality, and test-coverage passes in multiple clean REVIEW rounds, yet REVIEW to TEST rejected every pass because eligibilityDigest, eligibilityReasonCodes, and reviewBasisDigest changed under authoritative recomputation. The targeted review-incremental-context smoke passes, so add a real-story-history regression and fix only the recomputation inconsistency without weakening envelope validation.

Reproduce with historical findings/resolutions and prior review rounds matching B-5952; preserve fail-closed rejection for genuinely changed task, scope, runtime, role, findings cutoff, and material. Add a regression that fails before the fix and passes after it.
